en: A sepia-toned image shows a substantial fortified building with castle-like battlements and several stories. The architecture is somewhat Neo-Gothic or late 19th/early 20th-century institutional style. There is a guardhouse near the main entrance, and an early automobile is visible by the curb. The foreground includes cobbled streets and a leafy tree. The top left corner of the image reads: 'Dresden-II., König-Georg-Kaserne.'
